note: Every command is proposed for a future implementation slice and has not been run unless separately reported. Files marked NEW are exact future paths, not files created by this design worker. The tests are model/property/conformance oracles, not benchmarks.

slices.title: Define versioned ID shape and profile types
slices.goal: Add typed shape discriminator and strict version/profile parsing without changing any existing ID bytes.
slices.enables: Content and array cores can share dispatch while retaining separate identity semantics.
tests: No heuristic conversion between domain ID types
slices.oracle: A finite typed reference enum; every known encoding maps to exactly one variant, unknown critical tags return UnsupportedShape, and canonical encode(parse(x)) equals x.

slices.title: Add static/configured hash-profile dispatch
slices.goal: Dispatch self-describing profile tokens through static/configured code; prohibit per-object translation maps.
slices.enables: Portable IDs without requiring an extra runtime registry lookup.
tests: No mapping table access in parse/verify API
slices.oracle: Profile token selects exactly one compiled/configured verifier; all unsupported tokens reject before content processing.

slices.title: Pin legacy Iroh and artifact identity compatibility vectors
slices.goal: Record exact Iroh raw BLAKE3-256 vectors and separately pin legacy SHA-256 artifact serialization/signature bytes, including the docs/code preimage discrepancy.
slices.enables: Safe new profile parsing without silently changing identifiers or re-signing old artifacts.
tests: serde_json SignedBody serialization SHA-256 golden bytes
Ed25519 signature verification over preserved legacy preimage
slices.oracle: Known source implementation and fixed byte-level golden vectors. No serializer or signature preimage is changed by this slice.
slices.acceptance_command: FUTURE: cargo test -p id-core --test legacy_hash_vectors && cargo test -p id-sync --test legacy_artifact_vectors

slices.follow_up_issue: Proposed child issue: establish Atlas content_hash producer contract (not filed)
slices.title: Record Atlas chunk hash snapshot profile and missing writer boundary
slices.goal: Document observed SHA-256(UTF-8 chunk text) corpus snapshot values as a separate atlas-chunk-sha256-utf8 seam from ID raw-byte BLAKE3; file a follow-up for the missing production writer source/contract.
slices.enables: Explicit Atlas-to-ID joins without falsely equating ID content identity and Atlas chunk identity.
tests: Snapshot fixture verifies SHA-256(text encoded UTF-8) against supplied observed fixture rows
Schema consumer code does not claim to be the producer
slices.oracle: Exact checked-in source evidence plus immutable observed corpus fixture; never treated as proof of writer implementation or universal future producer contract.

slices.title: Specify canonical CBOR profile and byte-level vectors for new signed records
slices.goal: Define deterministic CBOR profile, duplicate-key rejection, critical field behavior and cross-language canonical vectors.
slices.enables: Stable body signatures and envelope IDs across Rust and hosted TypeScript.
slices.oracle: Independent reference vectors and byte equality across Rust/TypeScript; decoder rejects any ambiguous signed encoding.
slices.acceptance_command: FUTURE: cargo test -p id-core --test canonical_cbor_vectors && cd pkgs/id/hosted-worker && bun test canonical-cbor.test.ts

slices.title: Implement payload, body, signature and signed-envelope identity separation
slices.goal: Define PayloadId over raw bytes, canonical Body over payload ID/length/domain/context, signature over domain prefix plus Body, and EnvelopeId over full signed envelope.
slices.enables: Non-recursive signed snapshots and reusable receipt/assertion envelopes.
tests: PBT: envelope ID changes when signature changes
Body signature preimage excludes envelope ID/signature
PayloadId is raw exact payload hash
slices.oracle: Reference functions over canonical bytes; no signed preimage can contain the identity digest of its enclosing signed envelope.

slices.title: Encode complete signed metadata snapshot records
slices.goal: Store complete, scoped signed sidecar snapshots with parent generation and digest-derived snapshot ID.
slices.enables: Reproducible metadata versioning and location-index reconstruction.
tests: Snapshot ID over complete signed envelope
Timestamp variation does not define identity
slices.oracle: Canonical signed-envelope digest and a model of complete scope; snapshot digest is not recursively embedded in signed Body.

slices.title: Implement compare-and-swap metadata head and ABA protection
slices.goal: Update head only from expected generation and snapshot digest; refuse unsupported multiwriter adapters.
slices.enables: Lost-update safe current snapshot pointer.
tests: ABA old digest cannot overwrite newer generation
slices.oracle: State machine permits one CAS per expected head; each accepted generation has exact previous snapshot parent.

slices.title: Add legacy metadata read bridge and immutable snapshot migration
slices.goal: Read old metadata forms and create signed snapshots without modifying content bytes or claiming a consistent source snapshot without evidence.
slices.enables: Incremental adoption of signed sidecar format.
tests: Inconsistent source cannot publish complete snapshot
slices.oracle: Before/after data-model comparison plus fixed signed snapshot vector; only consistent source views may advance head.

slices.title: Bind existence acknowledgements to shared B19 receipt contract
slices.goal: Reuse Part B B19 V2 schema and bind responder, subject digest, scope, verified_present assertion kind, policy epoch and observation time.
slices.enables: Interoperable evidence without divergent receipt formats or future-retention promises.
tests: Verified presence differs from an unverified inventory observation
Old observation is not a retention promise
slices.oracle: Part B B19 V2 schema/vector; the slice requires that shared contract and must not fork it.

slices.title: Define typed R2, laptop and Drive location values
slices.goal: Represent locations by typed provider and scoped locator fields rather than opaque untyped path strings.
slices.enables: Safe location resolution, privacy filtering and backend-specific freshness handling.
tests: Laptop hostname/path is distinct from URL
Tenant and namespace scope are mandatory
slices.oracle: Typed enum reference model; no coercion between locator kinds and no scope-less locator accepted.

slices.title: Index every valid visible sidecar location with tombstone reconciliation
slices.goal: Build a rebuildable per-scope index from all authorized visible complete sidecar locations; model stale/delete tombstones and reconciliation cursor.
slices.enables: Fresh location queries with explicit completeness and version lineage.
tests: Tombstones prevent resurrection from stale snapshot
slices.oracle: Rebuilt index equals fold of validated signed sidecars and tombstones at scope epoch.

slices.title: Apply scope authorization before location candidate counts and projection
slices.goal: Filter unauthorized locator values and counts before ranking, caching or returning results.
slices.enables: Privacy-safe location harvesting in shared storage deployments.
tests: Logs redact raw path and user locators
slices.oracle: Authorization model: output/candidate counts are functions only of the authorized visible subset.

slices.title: Define local namespace registry record and two-core constraint
slices.goal: Bind a server-local namespace name to one of exactly two core IDs and explicit handler/config profiles.
slices.enables: Stable local resolution while preserving divergent domain-local registries.
tests: Same namespace name resolves differently in separate registries
slices.oracle: Finite model keyed by explicit resolver/registry identity; a definition cannot name an unknown third core.

slices.title: Implement versioned namespace registry state and authorization seam
slices.goal: Persist local registry generations and authorize mutations without merging unrelated ID world/group authority.
slices.enables: Version-aware, auditable local namespace configuration.
tests: Existing Iroh doc registry can coexist
slices.oracle: Registry state machine; mutation requires injected authorized context and increments one generation.

slices.title: Implement strict authority/path parser for settled internal id URI V1
slices.goal: Parse required lowercase resolver alias, UTF-8 namespace, v1 shape and typed array/content components without normalization or double decode.
slices.enables: Unambiguous RFC 3986-compatible local URI resolution.
tests: Malformed escapes and invalid namespace UTF-8
slices.oracle: RFC 3986 component parse followed by exactly one field-specific decode and exact grammar validation.

slices.title: Implement canonical formatter and caller-local resolver hint check
slices.goal: Emit lowercase aliases, uppercase percent escapes and settled null/bytes/content syntax; require selected local resolver alias equality.
slices.enables: Stable URI output without DNS/global resolution behavior.
slices.oracle: Golden URI examples and parse(format(value)) equals typed value; format(parse(canonical)) byte-identical.

slices.title: Port deterministic URI codec property and adversarial corpus to conformance tests
slices.goal: Use the stdlib reference codec's deterministic random cases and malformed corpus as Rust/TypeScript conformance vectors.
slices.enables: Cross-edition URI parity and protection against URI parser differentials.
tests: Malformed version, authority, delimiters, query/fragment reject
slices.oracle: Reference `uri_codec_reference.py self-test` output and fixed golden corpus; outcome equality across Rust and TypeScript.
slices.acceptance_command: FUTURE: python3 -I doc/2026-11-13T03-40-00Z_design_id-atlas-summit/part-a-addressing/uri_codec_reference.py self-test && cargo test -p id-core --test id_uri_property

slices.title: Implement nullable ordered byte-slot address type and codec
slices.goal: Encode/decode zero-or-more Option<Bytes> slots, preserving null versus empty bytes and slot order.
slices.enables: General array-address core semantics and URI slot payload model.
tests: Arbitrary slot count without domain fixed maximum
slices.oracle: Typed reference vector and byte-for-byte canonical round trip; values with different null/empty structure never collide.

slices.title: Define typed lexicographic ordering for array addresses
slices.goal: Implement null-before-bytes, unsigned-byte lexicographic, then shorter-prefix ordering.
slices.enables: Index order and deterministic pagination.
slices.oracle: Independent tuple comparator over Rust Option<Vec<u8>> values.

slices.title: Implement tagged typed values and arbitrary-object codec boundary
slices.goal: Preserve type ID plus bytes for values and require explicit codec profiles for structured objects.
slices.enables: Type-sensitive equality and safely extensible object serialization.
slices.oracle: Typed-value equality model and declared codec reference vectors.

slices.title: Implement per-namespace configured bare-string shorthand
slices.goal: Expand a bare UTF-8 string into slots using required configured default index; missing policy is an error.
slices.enables: Compact human query without hard-coding example index 2.
tests: Server override beats namespace default only where configured
slices.oracle: Pure expansion function compared with configured index reference; no fallback index exists.

slices.title: Add max-items result paging with snapshot-bound cursor
slices.goal: Bound each response page while keeping address length/result domain unbounded and exposing truncation, cancellation and cursor state.
slices.enables: Streaming interfaces that do not silently truncate.
slices.oracle: Reference sorted snapshot result; pages form disjoint ordered slices and cursor binds scope/query/snapshot.

slices.title: Implement immutable exact-byte raw-blake3-256 ContentId
slices.goal: Represent initial content ID as raw exact-byte Iroh BLAKE3-256 while retaining profile token and legacy binary/text forms.
slices.enables: Portable immutable content core with no metadata or location in identity.
tests: Metadata/location changes do not change ID
Atlas snapshot profile cannot parse as raw-blake3-256
slices.oracle: Pinned Iroh Hash::new implementation and published golden bytes; source profile mismatch is explicit error.

slices.title: Expose immutable content core adapter and verified streaming ingest
slices.goal: Commit content only after complete exact-byte digest match; preserve existing Iroh storage adapter boundary.
slices.enables: Uniform immutable content contract without rewriting event/world stores.
tests: Iroh store adapter reads old IDs unchanged
slices.oracle: Store-state model: object exists iff full stream length and digest validate; no partial staging object is accepted.

slices.title: Enforce universal signed-and-validated admission gate for both cores
slices.goal: Require signature, signer binding, semantic validation, namespace/tenant authorization and policy checks at every admission path, including local producers after signing.
slices.enables: One auditable acceptance invariant without trusted-local bypass.
tests: Enumerated ingress matrix including local write and hosted edge
Local producer signs then same gate verifies
slices.oracle: Ingress model: every accepted state transition has verified signature and all validation decisions; no route bypass exists.
slices.acceptance_command: FUTURE: cargo test -p id-core --test admission_gate && cd pkgs/id/hosted-worker && bun test admission-gate.test.ts

slices.title: Store string-path names as signed collision-preserving candidates
slices.goal: Keep original name spelling and all authorized signed target claims; do not silently choose one winner.
slices.enables: Ambiguity-aware name search and later lens projection.
tests: Unicode comparison profile does not mutate source name
slices.oracle: Reference signed candidate multiset and configured comparison profile.

slices.title: Implement explicit name lenses and voluntary authority-group filters
slices.goal: Project candidate sets through local override, popularity, cohort, standing and selected authority-group lenses with deterministic tie-breaks.
slices.enables: User-selectable name resolution without a global naming authority.
slices.oracle: Pure lens function over authorized candidate/evidence model; deterministic ordering for same policy version.

slices.title: Encode arbitrary integers, decimals and normalized binary floats
slices.goal: Add unbounded typed numeric significand/exponent values, canonical positive zero and reject NaN/infinity in ordered profile.
slices.enables: Infinitely growable numeric registry over array-address core.
slices.oracle: Arbitrary precision reference integer and exact exponent/significand model.

slices.title: Implement type-first numeric order with allocation-safe within-kind comparison
slices.goal: Order kinds by explicit stable type tag and compare values within kind without materializing huge exponent powers.
slices.enables: Correct range scans over large numeric values without coercion.
tests: Huge exponent does not allocate exponent-sized integer
slices.oracle: Reference comparator using virtual padded digits/bits and exact sign/magnitude arithmetic.

slices.title: Add numeric registry validator and configurable resource budgets
slices.goal: Apply numeric-kind validation at array writes while distinguishing operational parser limits from numeric domain limits.
slices.enables: Numeric semantics without a third address core.
tests: Valid large value is not rejected by fixed semantic max
slices.oracle: Namespace policy plus NumericValue validator; no max magnitude/precision semantic rule.

slices.title: Define signed stream descriptor, chunks and lifecycle state machine
slices.goal: Model addressable open stream with signed chained immutable chunks and one CAS terminal transition.
slices.enables: Text/chat/voice/video streams that are addressable while in progress.
slices.oracle: Finite lifecycle model with chain sequence/hash invariants; exactly one terminal record.

slices.title: Implement resumable stream subscription and completed target resolution
slices.goal: Subscribe/resume by chain cursor and return typed completion target with reauthorization rather than implicit redirect.
slices.enables: Live and replay consumers with explicit lifecycle outcomes.
slices.oracle: Reference stream chain prefix/suffix model plus current authorization result.

slices.title: Encode signer-local signed coordinate-world definitions
slices.goal: Sign immutable world definition over array coordinates, root reference, profile, signer and version with signer-local authority semantics.
slices.enables: Portable coordinate resolution without global registry or protocol monopoly.
tests: Local alternate mapping cannot claim signer authority
slices.oracle: COSE/reference signature vectors and world definition model; valid signature never implies global trust.

slices.title: Separate historical signature validity, current key status and local trust
slices.goal: Expose historical/current verification dimensions and define key rotation/revocation resolution seam without deciding SSO.
slices.enables: Auditable world horizon and compromise response.
slices.oracle: Explicit key history state machine; cryptographic validity, currentness and verifier trust are independent outputs.
